title: Collaborating with AI Agents: Field Experiments on Teamwork, Productivity, and Performance
abstract: arXiv:2503.18238v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We examined the mechanisms underlying productivity and performance gains from AI agents using a large-scale experiment on Pairit, a platform we developed to study human-AI collaboration. We randomly assigned 2,234 participants to human-human and human-AI teams that produced 11,024 ads. We evaluated the ads using independent human ratings and a field experiment on X which garnered ~5M impressions. We found human-AI teams produced 50% more ads per worker and higher text quality, while human-human teams produced higher image quality, suggesting a jagged frontier of AI agent capability. Human-AI teams also produced more homogeneous outputs (diversity collapse) as their ads were more self-similar. The field experiment revealed higher text quality (produced by human-AI teams) increased click-through rates and view time, while higher image quality (produced by human-human teams) improved cost-per-click rates. Two mechanisms explained

translated_title: 与AI智能体协作：关于团队合作、生产力与绩效的实地实验
translated_abstract: 我们通过在Pairit平台（一个我们开发的用于研究人机协作的平台）上开展的大规模实验，检验了AI智能体带来生产力与绩效提升背后的机制。我们将2,234名参与者随机分配到人人团队和人机团队中，共制作了11,024个广告。我们采用独立人工评分以及在X平台上获得约500万次曝光的实地实验来评估这些广告。研究发现，人机团队人均广告产出量高出50%，且文本质量更高；而人人团队制作的图像质量更高，这表明AI智能体的能力边界呈“锯齿状”（参差不齐）。此外，人机团队产出的广告同质性更强（多样性坍缩），其广告自我相似度更高。实地实验显示，更高的文本质量（由人机团队产出）提升了点击率和浏览时长，而更高的图像质量（由人人团队产出）改善了单次点击成本。
tldr: 该研究通过2,234名参与者的大规模随机实验发现，人机团队人均广告产出比人人团队多50%且文本质量更高，但人人团队图像质量更优、且人机协作导致产出多样性坍缩，揭示了AI智能体能力的锯齿状边界与人机协作中的多样性损失两大机制。
en_tdlr: A large-scale randomized experiment with 2,234 participants shows that human-AI teams produce 50% more ads per worker with higher text quality, while human-human teams achieve better image quality and greater output diversity—revealing a jagged frontier of AI agent capability and a diversity collapse in human-AI collaboration.
